title: Introduction
description: What is Spec ADE and why it exists.
content: Spec ADE is a full-stack GUI application for AI coding assistants. It provides a unified workspace where you can chat with AI agents, run integrated terminals, browse and edit files, manage git, and spawn autonomous agents.

title: Installation
description: Install Spec ADE on macOS, Linux, or Windows.
content: The fastest way to install Spec ADE via npm. Supports macOS Apple Silicon, Linux x86_64 and ARM64, Windows x86_64. Requires Node.js >= 18 and Git.

title: Quickstart
description: Your first Spec ADE session in 5 minutes.
content: This guide walks you through installing Spec ADE, opening a project, chatting with an AI agent, and spawning your first Claw.

title: Projects
description: How Spec ADE manages projects, file trees, and multi-project state.
content: A project in Spec ADE is a folder on your filesystem. When you add a project, Spec ADE indexes its file tree, tracks git status, and provides a workspace for AI agent sessions.

title: Sessions
description: Session lifecycle, CLI types, and tab management.
content: A session is a chat or terminal instance connected to an AI agent. Each session belongs to a project and uses a specific CLI tool.

title: Pane System
description: Recursive pane layout with 9 tab kinds, split, resize, and presets.
content: Spec ADE uses a recursive pane tree for its workspace layout similar to how JetBrains IDEs handle editor splits. You can split any pane horizontally or vertically.

title: Claws
description: Autonomous agent instances with permissions, scheduling, and lifecycle management.
content: A Claw is an autonomous agent instance that runs a skill against your project. Think of it as a background worker powered by an AI agent.

title: Skills
description: Reusable agent skills — discovery, packaging, and sharing.
content: A Skill is a packaged prompt and tooling configuration that you can attach to any Claw. Skills are discovered automatically from your workspace.

title: ACP Agents
description: Agent Client Protocol integration — custom agents, PTY vs ACP modes.
content: Spec ADE supports the Agent Client Protocol for connecting to AI agents beyond the built-in Auggie and Claude Code CLIs.

title: Worktrees
description: Git worktrees for parallel agent work without branch conflicts.
content: Spec ADE integrates git worktrees so each agent can work on its own branch without interfering with others or with your main branch.

title: Chat Interface
description: WebSocket-based chat with streaming, tool calls, and message history.
content: The chat interface is the primary way to interact with AI agents in Spec ADE. It provides real-time streaming responses with tool call visualization.

title: Terminal
description: Integrated PTY terminal with xterm.js, slash commands, and cross-platform shell support.
content: Spec ADE includes a full terminal emulator powered by xterm.js and PTY on the backend. It supports colors, cursor movement, and interactive programs.

title: File Editor
description: CodeMirror 6 editor with syntax highlighting, split panes, and media preview.
content: Spec ADE includes a code editor built on CodeMirror 6 with a custom VS Code-inspired dark theme, rainbow brackets, and indent guides.

title: Git Integration
description: Full git workflow — status, staging, commits, branches, merge editor, and diff viewer.
content: Spec ADE provides comprehensive git integration using git2 for fast local reads and git CLI for mutations and complex operations.

title: Search
description: Ripgrep-powered file content search with result navigation.
content: Spec ADE provides fast file content search powered by ripgrep with a grep fallback for systems where ripgrep is not available.

title: Keyboard Shortcuts
description: JetBrains-inspired keyboard shortcuts with context-aware priority.
content: Spec ADE uses a centralized shortcut system inspired by JetBrains IDEs. Shortcuts are context-aware.

title: Process Monitor
description: System metrics, GPU monitoring, process management, and sparkline charts.
content: Spec ADE includes a built-in process monitor that shows system metrics, running processes, and optional GPU information.

title: Desktop App
description: Tauri v2 native desktop app and PWA support.
content: Spec ADE is available as a native desktop application via Tauri v2, in addition to the browser-based and PWA modes.

title: Self-Hosting
description: Deploy Spec ADE on your own server — binary, Docker, or cloud.
content: Spec ADE compiles into a single binary that embeds the entire frontend SPA. No separate web server, no Node.js runtime needed.

title: Licensing
description: License portal, activation workflow, and plan options.
content: Spec ADE uses an offline license system based on Ed25519 digital signatures and JWT tokens tied to machine hardware fingerprint.

title: Custom Agents
description: Register and configure custom AI agents with PTY or ACP mode.
content: Spec ADE ships with two built-in agents but supports adding any AI coding tool as a custom agent.

title: Settings
description: Complete reference for all Spec ADE configuration options.
content: All Spec ADE settings are stored in settings.json and managed through the backend API. The UI provides a settings panel for common options.
